title: Impact of ACA Individual Mandate on Insurance Premiums
research_question: How did the enforcement of the Affordable Care Act's individual mandate affect health insurance premiums? This study aims to understand whether the mandate led to a decrease in premiums by comparing regions with different enforcement timings.
data_description: The dataset includes 150 observations with columns: unit_id (identifying regions), period (time periods before and after mandate enforcement), treated (indicator for regions where the mandate was enforced), post (indicator for periods after enforcement), treat_x_post (interaction term), and y (log insurance premiums).

ground_truth.identification_strategy: Compare regions before and after mandate enforcement.
ground_truth.conclusion_detail: The enforcement of the mandate led to a decrease in insurance premiums.
